timeline.summary: Shikha Yash Agrawal, Jindal Worldwide Limited’s promoter, disclosed no new encumbrances on JWL shares during FY2025-2026 beyond prior disclosures, complying with SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹640.18 Cr, net profit ₹26.13 Cr.
Amit Yamunadutt Agarwal, Jindal Worldwide Limited promoter, declared no substantial share acquisition or encumbrance for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Yamunadutt Amilal Agrawal (on behalf of Ms. Sarbatidevi Agrawal) declared no new encumbrances on Jindal Worldwide Limited shares in FY 2025-26.
